name: Emotional Abuse
overview: Scripture reveals that God is attentive to the cries of the righteous and acts justly on behalf of those who are oppressed, offering deliverance from their troubles. Believers are called to embody humility, patience, and love in their relationships, avoiding bitterness and harshness, especially within the family. Fathers are instructed to nurture their children with godly admonition rather than provoking them to anger, while husbands are commanded to love their wives without bitterness. Through walking by the Spirit, Christians are assured freedom from condemnation, enabling them to respond to emotional challenges with grace and Christlike character.
